sn9.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapatikkanto pokkharaṇim ogahetvā padumam upasiṅghati || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.14:2.1: Yam etaṃ vārijaṃ pupphaṃ || adinnam upasiṅghasi || ekaṅgam etaṃ theyyānaṃ || gandhattheno si mārisā ti || ||
sn9.14:3.1: Na harāmi na bhañjāmi || ārā siṅghāmi vārijaṃ || atha kena nu vaṇṇena || gandhattheno ti vuccati || ||
sn9.14:4.1: yvāyaṃ bhisāni khaṇati || puṇḍarīkāni bhuñjati || evam ākiṇṇakammanto || kasmā eso na vuccati || ||
sn9.14:5.1: ākiṇṇaluddo puriso || dhāti celaṃ va makkhito || tasmiṃ me vacanaṃ natthi || tañ cārahāmi vattave || ||
sn9.14:6.1: anaṅgaṇassa posassa || niccaṃ sucigavesino || vāḷaggamattam pāpassa || abbhāmattaṃ va khāyati || ||
sn9.14:7.1: addhā maṃ yakkha jānāsi || atho mam anukampasi || puna pi yakkha vajjesi || yadā passasi edisaṃ || || neva
sn9.14:8.1: taṃ upājīvāmi || na pi te katakammase || tvam eva bhikkhu jāneyya || yena gaccheyya suggatin ti || ||
sn9.14:9.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya {saṃvejito} {saṃvegam} āpādīti || || Vana-saṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ || ||
sn9.14:10.0: Tass-uddānaṃ || || Viveka Uppaṭṭhānañ ca || Kassapagottena ca || Sambahulā Ānando || Anuruddho Nāgadattañ ca || Kulagharanī
sn9.14:11.1: Vajjīputto || Vesalī Sajjhāyena ca || Ayoniso Majjhantikālamhi ca || Pākatindriya-padumapupphena cuddasa bhaveti || || ********************************************
